annotatorIndependence: Annotator did not read product source, tests, dist, engine, existing evaluation output or docs/RUN*. Prior site annotation URLs only used to exclude 35 source/final pages. No blind-v6 source page/title/feature details disclosed to root in progress or final messages before a root engine-freeze declaration.
independenceLimit: Process declarations and file hashes cannot by themselves prove cognitive/procedural independence from engine knowledge or unbiased sample selection.
annotationPolicy: Every reconstructive control annotated. General real HTTP links navigate; explicit JavaScript, inline popup, fragments, buttons and SSO locate. Own application/result inquiry is apply. Fixed source labels/ancestors/nearby public headings preserved. No actual input values, authentication, business actions, downloads or native UI.
limitations: Five purposively selected public-use pages; at least two expected main-content functions per page. Covers search/apply/help, not balanced over all six categories. No product, installation or live toolbar behavior observed by annotator.
